nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; stores token balances of each account.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; stores spending approvals.
uint256 private _totalSupply; total number of minted tokens.
string private _name; ERC20 token name, set once in constructor.
string private _symbol; ERC20 token symbol, set once in constructor.
string private constant _GENERATOR; constant generator URL.
string private _version; generator version string.
ERC20 constructor(string name_, string symbol_) writes _name and _symbol once.
name() public view returns the token name from _name.
symbol() public view returns the token symbol from _symbol.
decimals() public view returns fixed value 18.
totalSupply() public view returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf(address account) public view returns _balances[account].
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public; calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount).
allowance(address owner, address spender) public view returns _allowances[owner][spender].
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public; calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount).
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public; moves tokens via _transfer and reduces allowance via _approve.
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public; adds to allowance and calls _approve.
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public; checks balance and calls _approve with reduced allowance.
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal; mutates _balances, calls hook _beforeTokenTransfer and emits Transfer.
_mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal; increases _totalSupply and _balances[account], calls hook _beforeTokenTransfer.
_burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal; decreases _balances[account] and _totalSupply, calls hook _beforeTokenTransfer.
_approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal; writes _allowances[owner][spender] and emits Approval.
_beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual hook; empty by default but overridable.
Context._msgSender() internal view virtual returns msg.sender.
Context._msgData() internal view virtual returns msg.data.
ServicePayer constructor(address payable receiver, string serviceName) payable; performs external IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) call.
IPayable.pay(string serviceName) external payable interface function that receives ETH from the payer contract.
GeneratorCopyright constructor(string version_) writes _version.
generator() public pure returns the constant _GENERATOR string.
version() public view returns _version.
SimpleERC20 constructor(string name_, string symbol_, uint256 initialBalance_, address payable feeReceiver_) payable; requires initialBalance_ > 0 and mints to _msgSender().
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as token owner/recipient and as payer in constructors.
Balance mutation in _transfer: _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount; _balances[recipient] += amount.
Supply mutation in _mint: _totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount.
Supply mutation in _burn: _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount and _totalSupply -= amount.
Allowance mutation in _approve: _allowances[owner][spender] = amount.
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed in ServicePayer constructor with attacker-influenced receiver address.
Allowance arithmetic: currentAllowance - amount in transferFrom and currentAllowance - subtractedValue in decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by Context._msgSender(), making the caller identity propagate through the contract.
_msgSender() supplies the source address of transfer.
_msgSender() supplies the owner address of approve.
_msgSender() is used as the spender whose allowance is checked and reduced in transferFrom.
_msgSender() is the owner whose allowance is increased in increaseAllowance.
_msgSender() is the owner whose allowance is decreased in decreaseAllowance.
SimpleERC20 constructor mints the initial supply to _msgSender().
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes _mint(_msgSender(), initialBalance_).
SimpleERC20 constructor calls the payable ServicePayer constructor which forwards ETH to an external address.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the ERC20 base constructor with name and symbol.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the GeneratorCopyright base constructor.
ServicePayer constructor performs the external payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName).
ServicePayer constructor calls into the untrusted external IPayable contract, a callback entry point.
The receiver parameter determines the external contract address of the pay call.
The serviceName parameter is forwarded to the external pay call.
transfer delegates the state mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the token movement to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the summed allowance.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the reduced allowance.
_transfer calls the overridable hook _beforeTokenTransfer before mutating balances, an external callback surface.
_mint calls the overridable hook _beforeTokenTransfer before minting.
_burn calls the overridable hook _beforeTokenTransfer before burning.
_transfer performs balance subtractions and additions on _balances.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply and to the account balance.
_burn subtracts amount from the account balance and from _totalSupply.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom computes currentAllowance - amount before re-approving.
decreaseAllowance computes currentAllowance - subtractedValue before re-approving.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances state mapping.
_mint credits the _balances state mapping.
_burn debits the _balances state mapping.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
_approve writes the _allowances state mapping.
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] to validate the spender allowance.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply.
The mint operation updates the _totalSupply state variable.
The burn operation updates the _totalSupply state variable.
name() returns the _name state variable.
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable.
generator() returns the constant _GENERATOR string.
version() returns the _version state variable.
ERC20 constructor assigns the name_ argument into _name.
ERC20 constructor assigns the symbol_ argument into _symbol.
GeneratorCopyright constructor assigns version_ into _version.
The transfer balance mutation writes back into the _balances mapping.
The mint supply mutation writes back into _totalSupply.

The approval mutation writes back into the _allowances mapping.
